rows.why: Check the news first — we expect 9.4 but the line is 6.5. A gap this big usually means the sportsbook knows something (a role change, an injury). We expect about 9.4 carries vs the 6.5 line. We give the over 84% (needs 56% per pick on Underdog); recent games and the matchup both point higher
rows.why_long: Underdog higher 6.5 needs 56% per pick for your entry; fair view 85% (draftkings 13.5, moved to this line). Averaging 11.5 over the last 8 games, higher than 6.5 in 51% of them (raw 91%, shrunk 86%). Projects 9.4 (raw 79%, shrunk 84%).
why_points: The pick: Carries higher 6.5 on Underdog. Each pick has to win 56% of the time for a typical entry to make money; the sportsbooks' fair view (draftkings 13.5, moved to this line) is 85%.
Other apps: PrizePicks 13. This is the best number for the higher side.
Game log, most recent first: 3, 8, 2, 5, 17, 7, 10, 16. Weighted average 11.5; went higher than 6.5 in 5 of 8 games (51% recency-weighted).
Trending down: last 3 games average 4.3 vs 11.0 in the games before.
How much he swings: game to game he typically moves about ±4.9, so the line is 1.0 of those swings below his average (standard deviations) — a meaningful gap.
Teammate out: +4.3 car with Jeremiyah Love OUT. When a lead player sits, his teammates pick up about half his work (NFL 2019-25), so this prop is scaled +60%.
Projection: we expect 9.4 carries on average; in a typical game 9.1 (a few big games pull the average up, so the typical game is what we compare with the line) — 2.6 above the line.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 91% and the matchup 79%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 86%, matchup 84%.
Bottom line: we give it 84% to win and it needs 56%. The edge is the difference: +27.9 points; that works out to about +50¢ per $1 bet over the long run.
Risks: a raw read above 90% - where these methods were most overconfident.
rows.glance_head: The over looks good: we expect about 9.1 in a typical game vs the 6.5 line, and his recent games and the matchup agree.
